### 4. `TwoFactorAuthService` (Interface)
- **Interface:** `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/security/auth/mfa/TwoFactorAuthService.java`
- **Implementation:** `application/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/service/security/auth/mfa/DefaultTwoFactorAuthService.java`

### 5. `SecuritySettingsService` (Interface)
- **Interface:** `dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/settings/SecuritySettingsService.java`
- **Implementation:** `dao/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/dao/settings/DefaultSecuritySettingsService.java`

### 6. `RateLimitService` (Interface)
- **Interface:** `common/cache/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/cache/limits/RateLimitService.java`
- **Implementation:** `common/cache/src/main/java/org/thingsboard/server/cache/limits/DefaultRateLimitService.java`

---

> **Note:** `JwtTokenFactory` is also a direct dependency but it is a concrete `@Component` class (not an interface), so it has no separate implementation.
